name: eggfetch-http3-ordinary-client-corpus
description: Implementation-neutral HTTP/3 client semantics used by local and independent-server qualification.

cases.assertion: HEAD succeeds without a response body
buffered POST body is accepted and response is complete
streaming request body is sent once and completely
at least 1 MiB is consumed incrementally
trailers are available only after body EOF
concurrent requests complete over reusable H3 state
cancellation before response headers is prompt
upload cancellation releases the stream and resources
download cancellation releases the stream and resources
abrupt response termination is reported or bounded
graceful close preserves completed stream results
GOAWAY drains the generation and next work reconnects
repeated requests remain usable and bounded
authenticated Alt-Svc alternative port is usable
a restarted server is reachable after stale state
